''See also: [[Soulbound Vessel Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A [[Soulbound]] [[Vessel]] is an [[Awakened object]] that serves as the source of power for a [[Soulbound]] individual. These objects are typically small and unobtrusive, though they can range from jewelry and weapons to entire ships or sets of tools. To function as a [[Vessel]], the object must contain components or essence from an Elder or a [[Kameira]]. While many [[Vessels]] are single items, some individuals are bound to multiple objects or entire collections of tools. The relationship between a [[Soulbound]] and their [[Vessel]] is deeply personal and symbiotic. The connection allows the individual to wield extraordinary abilities, such as physical enhancement, elemental control, or even the ability to pilot complex vessels. This bond is so intimate that a [[Soulbound]] can sense their [[Vessel]]'s presence even from a distance, and the loss of a [[Vessel]] is described as feeling like losing a part of one's own body. Because the [[Vessel]] and the [[Soulbound]] are so closely linked, their desires and intentions often become intertwined. This can lead to a struggle for control, as the [[Vessel]] may possess its own urges or a sense of consciousness that competes with the user's will. While the power gained from a [[Vessel]] is instantaneous upon bonding, new [[Soulbound]] often face instability and difficulty managing the overwhelming influence of their object's intent. Consequently, identifying and securing a person's [[Vessel]] is a primary tactic for those seeking to neutralize their combat effectiveness.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] possesses a [[Soulbound]] [[Vessel]] that he is able to command. This vessel, which takes the form of his ship, responds specifically to his [[Intent]]. Rather than using spoken words, the entity communicates through a series of impulses, impressions, and physical pressure. [[Calder]] maintains a connection to the vessel by sensing its presence, while the cook also focuses his own power into the [[Soulbound]] [[Vessel]].}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[The Testament]] serves as the [[Soulbound]] [[Vessel]] for [[Calder]], though it is established that [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] also possesses one. While these vessels are often single items, they can alternatively manifest as a complete set of tools. The [[destruction]] of such an object can cause unpredictable mental consequences for the [[Soulbound]], as seen when a woman's face was ruined from her chin to her vessel. [[Calder]] is capable of repairing his own vessel through dedicated love, care, and attention. Additionally, Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster's [[Soulbound]] [[Vessel]] demonstrated the ability to take control during his loss of consciousness to ensure his survival.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[The Testament]] is [[Calder]]'s [[Soulbound Vessel]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] has a [[Soulbound Vessel]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A [[Soulbound Vessel]] can be a set of tools rather than a single object.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c18">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Destroying a [[Soulbound Vessel]] can have unpredictable effects on the mind of the [[Soulbound]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The woman's face was ruined from her chin to her [[Soulbound Vessel]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] can repair his [[Soulbound Vessel]] with love, care, and attention.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref>}}</li>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A [[Soulbound]] [[Vessel]] is a unique entity or power that can be bound to an individual, such as [[Tyria]]. While these vessels can manifest as objects like a helmet that induces a powerful berserk state, they are distinct from other equipment like [[Interion Darovish]]'s [[sword]] and shield. [[Loreli]], who raised her own [[Soulbound]] [[Vessel]], is able to tap into its power to generate light.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A [[Soulbound Vessel]] is a type of entity that can be bound to a person.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A [[Soulbound Vessel]] can be a helmet that allows the user to enter a powerful, berserk state.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Interion Darovish]]'s [[sword]] and shield are not his [[Soulbound Vessel]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c12">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A [[Soulbound Vessel]] is a specific type of object or power associated with individuals like [[Tyria]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Loreli]] raised her [[Soulbound Vessel]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c19">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Loreli]] taps into her [[Soulbound Vessel]] to make light.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
